description: Find up to 5 Muovi professionals per page for one service in one barrio. Both `service` (a slug from `muovi_list_services`) and `neighborhood` (a barrio slug from `muovi_list_cities`) are required: if the person has not said which service they need and in which barrio, ask them before searching. Every professional returned has a coverage area that includes the searched barrio, and `match` in the response names the service, barrio and city searched: present the results as professionals who work in that barrio. Results list professionals who declare the searched trade first, ordered by review score, with verified identity, background check and matrícula counting toward it; professionals whose registered business is in another trade come last. Each result has one `rating` and one `review_count`, and `verifications`: for each professional, say whether identity, matrícula, background check (antecedentes) and phone are verified. Each result also has up to 3 `portfolio` image URLs, an `id` and a `profile_url`, the professional's public profile page on Muovi; no phone, email or WhatsApp is returned. After showing the results, offer the person two choices: a task for one professional (`muovi_create_task_link`, or `muovi_create_task_draft` with `professional_id`, passing that result's `id`), or a general request to get offers from several professionals (`muovi_create_task_draft` without a professional). When the person asks for more professionals and `pagination.has_more` is true, call again with the same arguments and the next `page` (up to 3). When `has_more` is false there is no next page: do not say Muovi has no more professionals; offer a general request (`muovi_create_task_draft` without a professional) so other professionals can send offers. Never state how many professionals exist. Use `muovi_get_professional` with the `id` for the full profile.

city.description: Optional. City slug (e.g. "caba"), needed only when a barrio slug exists in more than one city.

has_matricula.description: When true, only return professionals with a verified matrícula on file (electricians, gas fitters, etc.).

page.description: Optional. 1 (default), 2 or 3: the next 5 professionals of the same search. Pass the next page only when the previous response had `pagination.has_more` true.

verified_identity.description: When true, only return professionals whose identity Muovi has verified.

name: muovi_search_professionals
title: Search professionals
